Subject: Re: NTL Digital TV quality (was Re: [ILUG] Broadband in Dublin)

(I know you meant to include ILUG in your email, so I think it's safe 
to presume you don't mind me quoting your mail to me to ILUG ;) ).

On Wed, 10 Oct 2007, Pete McEvoy wrote:

> As hard as it is to believe, since virgin took over NTL in the north,
> the situation has got much worse. You can count in seconds how long it
> is before you see a picture when you switch channel, when it works at
> all, and if you're just scanning up or down, when you stop on a channel
> you want, you'll find it keeps on switching channels anyway.

Wow, I'd take that back as defective.

I have two DVB-T STBs, a standalone, £19.99 Alba and one integrated 
in an LG TV. UI for both is perfectly responsive and both change 
channels quickly. The LG decoder sometimes drops video when you bring 
up an overlay menu though, but that doesnt matter much.

The differences to DVB-C presumably are minimal (at least on the UI 
and MPEG decoding sides?) enough that same responsiveness should be 
possible there. How do people put up with such lag??

> This is why some people choose to ignore some silly laws...

How do these laws get enacted though?

regards,
--
